title: Basic Immunofluorescence Protocol for Adherent Cells
author: Girija Goyal
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.wt4feqw
materials: For greater flexibility, primary antibodies are left unconjugated and detected using a secondary antibody which is specific to primary antibody (see guidelines) and are labeled with a fluorophore. Incubate in secondary antibody at the recommended dilution in staining buffer. See guidelines for dilutions of specific antibodies and duration of incubation.

steps.title: Fix cells with 4% PFA
steps.instruction: Remove culture media and submerge adherent cells in 4 % paraformaldehyde (Alfa Aesar Catalog #J61899‑AK) prepared in PBS; incubate 15 min at 20 °C. Cells may remain in fixative for several days at 4 °C if needed.

steps.title: Replace fixative with PBS
steps.instruction: Aspirate the PFA solution and add fresh PBS to cover the cells. Plates can be stored in PBS for up to 1 month at 4 °C.

steps.title: Permeabilize cells
steps.instruction: Aspirate PBS, add 100 µL permeabilization buffer, and incubate 10 min at 20 °C. Keep staining buffer at 4 °C for later use.

steps.title: Remove permeabilization buffer
steps.instruction: Aspirate the permeabilization buffer and add 100 µL PBS. After this wash, either proceed to the next step or store the cells in fresh PBS at 4 °C.

steps.title: Incubate primary antibody
steps.instruction: Dilute the primary antibody 1:100 in staining buffer, add to the cells, and incubate overnight (≈16‑18 h) at 4 °C. Store any remaining staining buffer at 4 °C.

steps.title: Post‑primary wash or reuse
steps.instruction: If reusing the diluted primary antibody, transfer it to a labeled tube for storage. Otherwise, aspirate the primary antibody, add PBS, and place the plate on a shaker for 5 min at room temperature; repeat this PBS wash two times.

substeps.instruction: Transfer remaining primary antibody to storage tube (optional).
Add PBS and shake 5 min at RT.

steps.title: Wash after secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Aspirate secondary antibody from the cells, add PBS, and shake the plate for 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Stain nuclei with Hoechst
steps.instruction: Replace PBS with Hoechst dye diluted 1:2000 in PBS, and incubate 20 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Final PBS washes and imaging
steps.instruction: Perform two additional washes with PBS as described in the previous wash step. Cells are now ready for visualization on the microscope.
